builtBy: Research by hand on 2026-11-13 and 2026-11-14. Clubs: the clubs’ own websites, read for the Instagram account each links. Teams (2026-11-14, the 41 girls volleyball teams): the schools’ athletics sites and their own pages, read by script (a handle a page links, names or holds in its settings), student papers, and web searches limited to Instagram; every team profile kept was then opened in a browser. Each record’s note says where its handle was found.
notes: Links, not sources: no fact on the site is read from an account (README "Instagram accounts", DATA-SOURCES §1.10).

A team’s account is its girls volleyball program’s own, or one the school’s girls and boys teams share (its note says so); never a boys-only account, the school’s or the athletics department’s account for every sport, a booster club’s, a club team’s or a player’s.

A profile whose name and bio do not say which school it is (several schools here share a name with one elsewhere) is left out unless a page of the school’s links it or the profile links the school’s own page.
No record means no account we could find and check on the day, not that there is none: 10 of the 41 teams have one. The search allowance gave most schools one search for all their sports.

teams.note: Found by search. Profile opened: "CUPERTINO GIRLS VOLLEYBALL", bio "we ball!", linking homecampus.com clearances. The school rests on the name and "tino", Cupertino High’s nickname; the profile names no city.

Found by search. Profile opened: "Homestead Volleyball", bio "HHS Volleyball | 1x CCS Girls Finalist | 1x CCS Boys Finalist | 1x Boys Nor-Cal Champions". One account for the girls and the boys; the CCS and Nor-Cal lines place it at Homestead, Cupertino. Not homestead.vb, which is Homestead High School’s in Fort Wayne, Indiana.

Linked as "Volleyball- Girls" on the social media page of the school’s athletics site (the boys have their own). Profile opened: "Los Gatos High School Girls Volleyball", bio "Los Gatos High School Official Women’s Volleyball Account"
Found by search. Profile opened: "MHS Girls Volleyball", bio "Official MHS GIRLS VB … 2025 CCS Division 1 Champs". The school rests on the handle and the CCS title.
Found by search. Profile opened: "Monta Vista Girl’s Volleyball", bio "2024 DII CCS CHAMPS & DIII NORCAL CHAMPS".

Credited by the school’s student sports magazine, Viking Magazine ("Photo courtesy of @palyvolleyball on instagram", girls volleyball season preview, 2023-08-31). Profile opened: "Paly Girls Varsity Volleyball", linking palyathletics.com’s girls volleyball schedule. A later Viking article credits @palygirlsvolleyball, a profile Instagram says is not available.

Linked from the "Volleyball, Girls" entry of the sports menu on the school’s athletics site. Profile opened: "GUNN GIRLS VOLLEYBALL", bio "Gunn High School Girl’s Volleyball Team", linking the Gunn Titans’ MaxPreps schedule
Found by search. Profile opened: "Branham.High.Volleyball", bio "The Official page of Branham High School Volleyball". One account for the school’s volleyball; it does not say girls only.

Found by search. Profile opened: "EVHS Girls Volleyball", bio "follow for games, news, and events!! #evhspride", linking the school’s own girls volleyball page (evergreenvalleyhigh.esuhsd.org/sports/volleyball-girls).

Linked on the "Sixers Social Media" page of the school’s athletics site as "Girls Volleyball: @indygirlsvolleyball" (the boys have their own). Profile opened: "ihsgirlsvball", bio "The official account for the Independence Highschool Girls Volleyball 2026-2027 team!"
